mapper.select: select r.id, r.processes, r.user_name, u.email from t_production_reminder_user r left join sys_user u on u.user_name = r.user_name and u.del_flag = '0' where r.del_flag = '0' and r.processes is not null and r.user_name is not null and u.email is not null
